storage_roles.evidence_events: append-only canonical raw EvidenceEvent payloads; source of replay truth
storage_roles.event_semantic_targets: append-only denormalized semantic query index derived atomically from accepted evidence
storage_roles.identity_links: identity-to-academic-history links; later authenticated identity does not rewrite historical evidence
storage_roles.recommendations: append-only NBA proposals; never canonical mastery truth
storage_roles.recommendation_outcomes: append-only evaluation of recommendation delivery/outcome linked to evidence refs when available
storage_roles.materialized_snapshots: mutable rebuildable cache/view only; never raw evidence truth

idempotency.event_id: same payload returns ALREADY_APPLIED; different payload is integrity conflict
idempotency.idempotency_key: logical replay ignores regenerated event_id/server receive identity but rejects changed educational payload
idempotency.legacy_alignment: preserves adapter-279 principle that replay appends no duplicate evidence/state delta

effective_history.performance_and_legacy_events: eligible as evidence after schema acceptance
effective_history.correction: append-only correction suppresses referenced superseded event in effective replay while preserving both raw records
effective_history.retraction: append-only retraction suppresses referenced event in effective replay; raw history remains durable
effective_history.correction_chain_policy: reference-conservative; no implicit revival semantics are frozen for production by this task

deterministic_recompute.ordering: server_sequence when present, then received_at_server/created_at, then event_id
deterministic_recompute.mastery_readiness_retention_nba: delegated to existing subject-neutral PEIS reference kernel

telemetry.policy: raw telemetry summary is observational and does not directly mutate mastery
